card.name: First digit of converted number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number that is about to continue, mostly a converted measurement in parentheses after a unit, such as feet to meters or MBq to mCi. It also fires on leading digits of day or hour counts.

modes.label: Converted units in parentheses
modes.description: First digit of the second value in a unit conversion, right after an opening parenthesis.
modes.example: sensors designed to track their prey, including: Chemical sensors - mosquitoes can sense carbon dioxide and lactic acid up to 100 feet (<<3>>6 meters) away.

modes.label: Durations in days or hours
modes.description: First digit of a time span like 40 days or 34 to 36 hours.
modes.example: And Jesus went into the wilderness for <<4>>0 days of soul-searching solitude.

card.writes: It favors symbols that follow numbers, like %, ″, ² and ½, so it expects the number to be completed and followed by a unit.
card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of a number whose remaining digits and unit are still to come, especially a converted measurement.
